summary: Iteration 17 backend tests: SAP brand bleed-through (Pfizer active) across config/sales-orders/purchase-orders/materials/sync-logs/open-deliveries, /api/integrations host swap, KPI network_metrics brand drift, and full Server Registry CRUD + ping + admin-role enforcement. 21/21 pytest passed.

minor.issue: Review request listed dispatcher token as 'test_session_disp_1' but the actual valid token (per /app/memory/test_credentials.md and /api/auth/me) is 'test_disp_session'. Used the correct one in tests.

action_items: (Doc) Update review-request template / test_credentials reference so future iterations use 'test_disp_session' for dispatcher.
Consider adding a deterministic seed lock on /api/kpis network_metrics so brand drift values don't change between calls (currently they appear stable, but worth a code review).
critical_code_review_comments: _brand_tenant_strings (server.py ~1688) does substring replacement on response strings. The catch-all 'tennant' -> slug at the end works but is fragile — any new field containing the word 'Tennant' anywhere will get swapped. Consider an explicit allowlist or a marker-based template approach long term.

_detect_system_servers always returns health='healthy' for system::api and system::ingress without an actual probe (only mongo is real-probed). The 'healthy' badge is therefore optimistic for those rows — at minimum, label them 'reported' vs 'probed' so admins know which were measured.

POST /api/admin/servers does not validate that hostname is a plausible host or that protocol is one of the documented enum values; an admin can store 'protocol: banana'. Add Pydantic Literal[...] validators.

/api/admin/servers/{id}/ping uses httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=4.0) and socket.create_connection blocking inside an async handler (TCP path). The blocking socket call will stall the event loop on slow networks — move to asyncio.open_connection.
server.py is now 8364 lines — past the 700-line threshold. The Server Registry block, SAP block, and ERP connectors block are each self-contained and should be split into separate routers/modules.
MongoDB _id is correctly excluded from servers_registry reads via projection {'_id': 0} ✓.
Custom server POST returns the raw insert dict; that's fine, but consider stripping any future secret fields before returning to the client.
test_credentials: admin: test_session_admin_1 (Bearer). dispatcher: test_disp_session (Bearer). Review-request value 'test_session_disp_1' is INVALID — use 'test_disp_session'.
seed_data_creation: Tests created two TEST_-prefixed custom servers (TEST_HealthURL Server, TEST_TCP Server) and cleaned them up via DELETE at end of run. db.servers_registry should be empty of TEST_ rows after run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Active brand in /api/branding is Pfizer Inc. (brand_id=pfizer, short_name=Pfizer, slug=pfizer). SAP host should swap to s4hana.pfizer.sap.com and user prefix should not start with TENNANT. /api/kpis network_metrics is a dict of category -> list[metric], NOT a flat metric->value dict — find on_time_pickup via [m for grp in nm.values() if isinstance(grp, list) for m in grp]. Pfizer on_time_pickup observed ≈ 93.04 vs Tennant baseline 95.3. Server Registry: system::api, system::mongo, system::llm always present; system::ingress present when PUBLIC_APP_URL/REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is set. PATCH/DELETE on system::* IDs return 400. Custom server IDs are 'SRV-' + 10 hex chars uppercase.
verified_flows: GET /api/sap/sales-orders, purchase-orders, materials, sync-logs, open-deliveries — no 'tennant' substring anywhere in serialized response
GET /api/integrations contains 'pfizer' slug; tennantco.sharepoint.com and powerbi.com/tennant are absent
GET /api/kpis network_metrics on_time_pickup = 93.04 (drifted from 95.3 Tennant baseline)
GET /api/admin/servers returns {system[4], custom[], totals} — system includes system::api, system::mongo, system::llm, system::ingress
POST /api/admin/servers creates SRV-<10HEX> doc with system=false; persisted and returned by next GET
PATCH /api/admin/servers/{id} updates notes; PATCH on system::api → 400
DELETE /api/admin/servers/{id} removes; DELETE system::mongo → 400; DELETE unknown → 404
POST /api/admin/servers/{id}/ping with hostname=1.1.1.1, port=443 performs TCP probe and returns health/ping
